# Goethe-Institut

> > The Goethe-Institut is Germany's worldwide cultural institution promoting German language education and international cultural cooperation.

The site features the Deutschstunde Portal, a comprehensive resource hub for German as a Foreign Language (DaF) and German as a Second Language (DaZ) teachers. It provides teaching materials, methodology articles through Magazin Sprache, and networking opportunities through initiatives like PASCH (Schools: Partners for the Future).

## Key Topics

- German as a Foreign Language (DaF)
- German as a Second Language (DaZ)
- Deutschstunde Portal
- PASCH (Schools: Partners for the Future)
- Kompendium DaF/DaZ
- Teaching Methods and Didactics
- Multilingual Learning
- Language Education
- Teacher Networking
- GFL (German as a Foreign Language)
- GSL (German as a Second Language)
- PASCH-net Community
- Magazin Sprache
- DaF Teaching Resources
- International Cultural Cooperation

## Teacher Resources and Networking

- [Networking - Deutschstunde Portal](https://www.goethe.de/prj/dlp/en/network): Goethe-Institut networking hub for teachers via PASCH and other platforms

## Magazin Sprache - Teaching Methods and Articles

- [Magazin Sprache Article List (English)](https://www.goethe.de/prj/dlp/en/magazin-sprache): Goethe-Institut's Magazin Sprache articles on DaF/DaZ teaching methods
- [Magazin Sprache Artikelliste (Deutsch)](https://www.goethe.de/prj/dlp/de/magazin-sprache): German version of Magazin Sprache articles with topic filters
